items.stem:
A currency exchange buys Japanese yen at a rate of 1 JPY = 0.05732 HKD. The boss uses the following Python program for calculating the price payable to the customer:
JPY  amount in Japanese yen
HKD  JPY * 0.05732
Output round(HKD, 1)

parts.label: a
parts.text: How much in HKD can a customer get if they sell 5500 JPY?(1 mark)

parts.label: b
parts.text: What error does this result contain?(1 mark)

parts.label: c
parts.text:
Find the value of the error. Will the customer or the currency exchange benefit from it?(2 marks)
[--Answer:
(a) 315.3 HKD
(b) The value of HKD has a rounding error.

parts.label: c
parts.text:
|315.26-315.3| = 0.04
The customer will benefit because the value is rounded up in this case.
--]

items.stem: Workers in ABC Company should work for 40 hours per week. However, some workers may work overtime and some may work undertime. Chris, the HR manager of the company, is making a report on the working hours of workers in a given department. The total working hours of each worker in the previous week are stored in array hours.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Chris writes the following Python program to count the respective numbers of workers who have worked overtime and those who have worked undertime. Complete the program.(2 marks)
Line  Python
1    hours = [40, 35, 40, 50, 38, 51, 40, 53]
2    overtime = 0
3    undertime = 0
4    for i in range(0, 8):
5        if _______________:
6            undertime = undertime + 1
7        elif _______________:
8           overtime = overtime + 1
9    print("No. of workers who worked overtime:", overtime)
10   print("No. of workers who worked undertime:", undertime)

parts.label: b
parts.text: If a breakpoint is added to line 5, what will be the values in variables overtime and undertime when the program is paused for the sixth time?(1 mark)

parts.label: c
parts.text:
Suggest a series of test data to verify the above program.(1 mark)
[--Answer:

parts.label: a
parts.text:
hours[i] < 40
hours[i] > 40
(b) overtime = 1, undertime = 2
(c) 30 (or any value smaller than 40), 40, 50 (or any value larger than 40)
--]

(a) Chris writes the following Python program to count the respective numbers of workers who have worked overtime and those who have worked undertime. Complete the program.(2 marks)

1    hours = [40, 35, 40, 50, 38, 51, 40, 53]
2    overtime = 0
3    undertime = 0
4    for i in range(0, 8):
5        if _______________:
6            undertime = undertime + 1
7        elif _______________:
8           overtime = overtime + 1
9    print("No. of workers who worked overtime:", overtime)
10   print("No. of workers who worked undertime:", undertime)
(b) If a breakpoint is added to line 5, what will be the values in variables overtime and undertime when the program is paused for the sixth time?(1 mark)
(c) Suggest a series of test data to verify the above program.(1 mark)

(a) hours[i] < 40
hours[i] > 40
